name: o44298

schema.description: The options of a media object. An instance of a scene media options object.

autoPause.description: Does the video need to be paused automatically when the page is not visible anymore ?
autoPause.title: Autopause

autoPlay.description: Does the video need to be played automatically at start ?
autoPlay.title: Autoplay

autoResume.description: Does the video need to be resumed automatically when the page is visible again ?
autoResume.title: Autoresume

loop.description: Does the video need to be looped automatically at the end of playing ?
loop.title: Loop

startTime.description: Set the current position (in seconds) of the video playback.
startTime.title: Start Time

schema.title: SceneMediaOptionsConfig

description:
The video for this scene is set to pause automatically whenever the page is no longer visible, and it will resume playback as soon as the page becomes visible again. It will **not** start playing on its own when the scene loads, but it will begin from a timestamp of **12.5 seconds** into the clip. Looping is disabled, so the media will stop after reaching the end.

Audio is configured at a moderate level, with the volume positioned at **75 %** of the maximum. All other playback options follow the defaults outlined above.
